title: Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply - Create

ancestors.title: Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply

storage.value:
User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to create Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply object in the system

So that I will have possibility to cancel termination process for the PODs for which the overdue liabilities are fully paid, or for which the remaining unpaid amount is strictly less than Liability amount from on the linked Request for disconnection of the power supply

 

Design: Cancellation_Of_Disconnection)Of_The_Power (adobe.com)

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Creating a Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply is possible from its listing page by clicking on a 'Plus' button

  2. Clicking on a Plus button will open Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply's creation page

  3. Check system user permissions to be able to create a new Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply

    1. For creating such object, user should have any permissions listed here:

      1. Create Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply as  a Draft

        1. System user with this permission is able to save the object as a draft.

        2. System user with this permission is not able to save and execute the Cancellation object.

      2. Create Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply as Execute

        1. System user with this permission is able to save and execute the cancellation object.

    2. Enable Plus button when user has one of the permissions

    3. Disable Plus button when user does not have any of the mentioned permissions

  4. Default state of the Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply object contains fields:

    1. Number

      1. Mandatory

      2. Always disabled

      3. Empty on creation page

      4. Text field

      5. After creating an object, system should display its number with the following logic:

        1. Cancellation-ID of newly created object (For example, Cancellation-56)

          1. In the given example, Cancellation is hardcoded prefix for number and 56 is ID of an object

    2. Date

      1. Mandatory

      2. Always disabled

      3. Date picker

      4. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

      5. By default, should set current day of the creation

    3. Status

      1. Mandatory

      2. Always disabled

      3. Empty on creation page

      4. Two hardcoded values:

        1. Draft

        2. Executed

      5. System should automatically set a value according to the status of the object

        1. If it is saved as a draft should set Draft

        2. If it is saved and executed should be set Executed

    4. Table

      1. Table should be displayed only after user selects 'Request for disconnection of the power supply'

        1. If Request for disconnection of the power supply is not added to the object, list should be empty

      2. Before displaying the table, for each POD the system should calculate the remaining unpaid amount as the sum of current amounts of overdue liabilities that were included in the Reminder for disconnection of the power supply for that POD and that relate to the linked Request for disconnection of the power supply (compared to the creation date of the Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply object). The sum should use only the current amounts of those liabilities and should not include tax. Liability amount from is read from the linked Request for disconnection of the power supply and is not entered on the Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply screen.

        1. If remaining unpaid amount is 0, POD should be marked and in the Cancellation Reason should be set default value (For example, Customer Paid) and the row should be disabled

          1. Prechecked and can not be unchecked manually.

        2. If remaining unpaid amount is greater than 0, Liability amount from is set on the linked Request for disconnection of the power supply, and remaining unpaid amount is strictly less than Liability amount from, POD should be marked and in the Cancellation Reason should be set default value (For example, Customer Paid) and the row should be disabled

          1. Prechecked and can not be unchecked manually.

        3. If remaining unpaid amount is equal to or greater than Liability amount from, or Liability amount from is not set on the linked Request for disconnection of the power supply, it is possible manually to select POD and choose value from the nomenclature in the Cancellation Reason field

      3. Table for cancellation includes following columns:

        1. Checkbox for selecting PODs

          1. Marked and disabled if POD is preselected

          2. Empty and optional if POD is not preselected

          3. Searching is possible:

            1. All

            2. Customer identifier

            3. Customer number

            4. POD Number

        2. Customer

          1. Mandatory

          2. Always disabled

          3. System should automatically display all the selected customers from the added 'Request for disconnection of the power supply' object

          4. Customers should be displayed with its identifier and name + legal form in format 5520222522 (COPANY JSC)

        3. Point of Delivery

          1. Mandatory

          2. Disabled and marked if the POD is preselected (remaining unpaid amount is 0, or remaining unpaid amount is strictly less than Liability amount from on the linked Request for disconnection of the power supply)

          3. Enable and optional if the POD is not preselected

            1. It is possible to manually select the checkbox

            2. Display each POD separately in this list.

            3. if one customer has more than POD, customer should be displayed repeatedly.

        4. Cancellation Reason

          1. Mandatory

          2. List is manageable from nomenclature

            1. Active values should be returned from the nomenclature

            2. Display default if returned from nomenclature

          3. If the POD is preselected, then should display default value - (For example, Customer Paid)

          4. Do not display Dropdown default item if the POD is not checked in this list.

      4. Format of the table:

        1. By default, should display 25 records in one page with the possibility to change the number of displayed items in a page.

        2. Hardcoded values for dropdown: 25, 50, 100

        3. Total count of POD records should be loaded

      5. Pagination:

        • To be able to navigate through next/previous page

        • To be able to navigate to first/last page

        • To be able to use arrow back/forward for navigation

        • To be able to go to a certain page from dropdown with available pages

        • To be able to type page number and after clicking on Enter will directly load that page

    5. Sub-objects:

      1. Request for disconnection of the power supply

        1. Mandatory

        2. Table should be displayed after adding Request for disconnection of the power supply object

        3. When user has created second Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply object for one Request and its status is Executed, already terminated PODs shouldn't be displayed in the second cancellation object

        4. Only one object should be added

        5. It is possible to create as much Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply's object until all the PODs are terminated in the Request for disconnection of the power supply object

        6. Request for disconnection of the power supply is added manually by clicking on a Plus button

          1. When user clicks on a Plus button modal window should be opened with one single select dropdown

            1. In the dropdown Request for disconnection of the power supply objects should be displayed with its name

            2. do not display deleted objects.

            3. Display only executed objects

            4. It is possible to search object by its name

        7. After adding Request for disconnection of the power supply it should be displayed with its number

        8. It is possible to go to the detail page by clicking on a label or an arrow

        9. It is possible to delete already added object by clicking on a delete icon

      2. Template

        1. Optional

        2. It is possible to add more than one template to the object

        3. Clicking on Plus button will open a modal window with single select dropdown, from where it should be possible to choose template

          1. Templates should be displayed with its name

          2. It is possible to search templates with its name

        4. It is possible to download attached template

        5. It is possible to delete selected template from the object by clicking on delete icon

        6. When template is attached to the object, it means system to generate a file according to the template after clicking on 'Save' button and send it to the grid operator at the defined email address from nomenclature

      3. Task

        1. Always empty and disabled on creation page

        2. Will be available on edit/preview mode

        3. Tasks displaying logic / format:

          1. In the task sub-object, a maximum of 10 tasks should be displayed. If the number of tasks exceeds 10, pagination should be shown. If there are 10 or fewer tasks, pagination should not be visible.

          2. Task list logic:

            1. The tasks ordering should be descending by time creation

            2. Also the task format should be changed, we need to have the next format:

              1. Id

                1. Take from task number field - This logic is already added

              2. Display task status

                1. Task status should be taken from task object

                2. In the system we have the next task statuses:

                  1. Open

                  2. In Progress

                  3. Terminated

                  4. Overdue

                  5. Completed

              3. Date in format DD.MM.YYYY

                1. This logic is already added.

              4. Task type

                1. Task type should be taken from task type dropdown - this logic is already added

              5. Example:

                1. 841 - in progress – 26.02.2025 - YOLS-TEST

      4. File

        1. Enabled

        2. Optional

        3. Files can be added manually by the system user

        4. In this sub-object system should display generated documents according to the Template when user clicks on ‘Save’ button

        5. Adding file is possible by clicking on a Plus icon

        6. User is able to upload more than one file.

        7. It is possible to preview files when clicking on its name or an arrow

        8. It is possible to delete files - only added manually, generated by the system files cannot be deleted

        9. After adding the file, it should be displayed with file name

        10. Max size: 50 MB

  5. Save as a draft button

    1. Enable if user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save as a draft button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If all the validations are successful, then system should create new Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply object and display it in the listing page (shouldn't start process until its status is Draft)

      2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

      4. Save information about Checked rows of the Table of the Cancellation of a disconnection.

        1. the Table should be refreshed every time user opens Draft cancellation object on edit or Preview mode.

  6. Save and Execute button

    1. Enable is user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save and execute button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If all the validations are successful, then system should create new Cancellation of a disconnection of the power supply object and display it in the listing page (it is possible to start process)

      2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

      4. Save information from the Cancellation table in DB.

        1. Checked Information about Checked rows should be saved in DB.

      5. For each selected POD system should check taxes for the grid operator nomenclature’s Remove tax in Cancelation Checkbox

        1. If it’s checked should cancel taxes for request of the disconnection of power supply

        2. If it’s not checked do nothing

  7. When clicking on 'Cancel' or 'X' button warning pop-up message should appear: 'Are you sure you want to cancel?' Yes/No

    1. Yes - will close pop-up and user is returned to the listing page

    2. No - will close pop-up and user stays on the current page

    3. Warning message should be managed from the system settings
